pr.title: docs(conport): search delegation boundary — search_type enforcement + Memory Trinity note
pr.body: Documents the ConPort structured-vs-semantic search boundary per Memory Trinity ADR. Adds docstring to search_content in enhanced_server.py explaining that search_type=decisions searches decisions only, search_type=progress searches progress_entries only, search_type=all searches both, and that semantic/vector search is delegated to dope-context (not ConPort). Enforces search_type validation (422 on unknown values). Updates docs/systems/conport/surface-equivalence-and-drift.md with the delegation note. Adds regression tests confirming search_type=decisions returns no progress rows and vice versa. Depends on 105 (search and FTS) having established the baseline search surface.
